theInstrumentDecidedPreBuild.theQuestionTheDesignCannotAnswerForItsel: Every defect in the correction list was a DRAWING asserting something about CODE, and the drawings are regenerated by gen.mjs from source-state that a human dumped. Nothing forced the two to agree: gen.mjs could be edited, or the dump could be taken at an old ref, without either looking wrong.
theInstrumentDecidedPreBuild.decision: The instrument is a comparison against the product's own output, never against itself: dump-source-state.mjs runs the product's composers at a named git ref; gen.mjs renders the artboards and embeds machine-readable attributes (data-determination, data-badge, data-marker, data-provenance, data-author, data-citation, data-whole-chain); check.mjs reads the RENDERED html and compares each value to the source-state; violate.mjs plants violations on the real boards and asserts check.mjs catches each one AND that the unmodified board passes.
theAbortConditionsDeclaredInAdvance: no source-state.json (or unparsable) -> exit 2, no verdict -- an empty result is not an absence
a board whose data-board marker was removed is not read at all -> exit 2 rather than reading a board that failed closed
a predicate that matches nothing across every board -> exit 2, refusing a verdict, because a check nobody can fail is not a check
every predicate reports its matched-input count, and the run prints all of them, so a vacuous PASS is visible as a zero rather than as a pass
theInstrumentDecidedPreBuild.theWrongDirectionIsTestedFirst: violate.mjs runs each acceptance item in BOTH directions: plant the violation and require the catch, remove it and require PASS. All 27 cases run on the real artboard set, not on fixtures.
